svg.text: Automated Device Enrollment: from Apple Business Manager to Company Portal

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A yearly token handshake between Intune and ABM, then a zero-touch path for every new Mac: Setup Assistant, modern sign-in, a locked MDM profile, and Company Portal as a required app.

svg.text: The ABM token expires after one year and a token error also follows changed ABM terms: renew in ABM, upload, sync. The APNs certificate is

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: renewed, never re-created, or every Apple device must re-enroll.

svg.text: 14 steps: 5 once a year, 9 per Mac. Result: supervised, locked, always Corporate. Controls: CM-8 (inventory with owner and ownership type), CM-3 (restrictions under change control).

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Generalised design: no client names, tenant IDs, addresses or data. Icons are simplified originals, not Microsoft artwork.
